dos2utf8.py.summary: Convert the text files below the current directory to UTF-8 with LF line endings.
details: Decodes each file as UTF-8 (falling back to Latin-1), normalizes CRLF and lone CR to ``\n`` and rewrites the file only when the bytes change. Files are processed in a worker pool.

dupf.py.summary: Find duplicate files by hashing their contents with xxhash.
details: Hashes every file below the given paths (``.git``, ``__pycache__`` and the other cache directories are skipped) and prints the groups of files that share a hash, largest duplicates first. ``--pool-method`` selects how the hashing jobs are distributed.

egg2whl.py.summary: Convert an unpacked ``.egg`` directory into a wheel.
details: Reads ``PKG-INFO`` for the distribution name and version, writes a matching ``setup.py`` into a temporary copy of the egg and calls ``pip wheel`` on it, leaving the resulting ``.whl`` in the current directory.

email_collector.py.summary: Crawl a website, store the HTML in SQLite and harvest the e-mail addresses.
details: Follows links on the same hostname (two levels deep) for the given start URL, keeps the pages in ``data/crawler.sqlite`` with the HTML under ``data/html/``, extracts the e-mail addresses it finds and writes them to ``data/emails.csv`` (domains to ``data/domains.csv``). ``--emails``/``-e`` only exports what is already in the database.

email_crawler.py.summary: Crawl a website two levels deep, cache the pages in SQLite and collect e-mail addresses.
details: Starts at the URL given on the command line, follows same-host links, stores each page in ``data/crawler.sqlite`` and its HTML in ``data/html/``, then writes the harvested addresses to ``data/emails.csv`` and the domains to ``data/domains.csv``. Logs go to ``logs/``.

empt.py.summary: Empty a file by truncating it to zero bytes.
details: Writes an empty string to the given path, which clears the content while keeping the file (and its permissions) in place.

emptypkg.py.summary: Find Python packages and wheels that contain no importable code.
details: Scans the given directories (or the current one) for ``.whl`` files whose ``RECORD`` lists nothing outside ``.dist-info`` and for installed ``*.dist-info`` directories without a module, then prints them, optionally writing the list to a CSV.

emptywhl.py.summary: List the empty ``.whl`` files in the current directory.
details: A wheel counts as empty when its ``RECORD`` only mentions files inside the ``.dist-info`` directory, i.e. the package ships metadata but no importable code. Corrupt archives are ignored.

encryptor.py.summary: Encrypt or decrypt the text files below the current directory with AES.
details: ``--encrypt`` generates a random key, prints it and encrypts every file it walks in place (IV stored with the ciphertext); ``--decrypt --key KEY`` reverses the operation. Binary files are skipped.

ensurebracket.py.summary: Check that the brackets in Python files are balanced.
details: Walks the characters of each file against a stack of ``(``/``[``/``{`` and prints the name of every file whose brackets are balanced. Files are checked in a worker pool; the files with an unbalanced result are simply not printed.

ex_comments.py.summary: Collect the import statements of every Python file into per-folder ``imports.py`` files.
details: Parses the tree below the current directory with tree-sitter, takes the import (and comment) statements of each module and writes them grouped by folder to ``output/<folder>/imports.py``. Hidden folders and ``site-packages`` are skipped.
ex_comments.py.notes: Runs at import time; start it from the tree to scan.

excss.py.summary: Extract the inline ``<style>`` blocks of HTML files into ``css/`` files.
details: Parses each HTML file with BeautifulSoup, writes every ``<style>`` block to a randomly named ``css/xxxx.css`` (ten characters) and processes the files in parallel. Without arguments it handles every ``.html``/``.htm`` file below the current directory.

exjs.py.summary: Extract the inline ``<script>`` blocks of HTML files into ``js/`` files.
details: Parses each HTML file with BeautifulSoup and writes every ``<script>`` block to a randomly named ``js/xxxx.js`` file, skipping blocks whose target already exists. Without arguments it handles every HTML file below the current directory.

extinfo.py.summary: Report file extensions and their total sizes in the current directory tree.
details: Walks the tree, groups the files by extension and either prints the total size for one extension or, with ``--all``, a table of every extension found with its count and size.
